en.metaDescription: How Hsin-Hsin Yuan's portfolio handles information submitted through its contact form.
en.intro: This notice explains how information submitted through this portfolio is handled. The portfolio is operated by Hsin-Hsin Yuan in Taiwan.

sections.heading: Who handles your information
paragraphs: Hsin-Hsin Yuan determines why information submitted through this portfolio is used. Privacy requests can be sent through the same portfolio Contact form.

sections.heading: What is collected
paragraphs: If you use the Contact form, it collects the Name, email address, project type, optional link, and message that you choose to provide.
The hosting provider may also process technical request information, such as an IP address, browser or device information, timestamps, and request logs, to deliver and secure the site.

sections.heading: Why it is used
paragraphs: Information is used only to respond to your inquiry, assess or discuss possible work, keep necessary professional correspondence, and protect the form from abuse.
It is not sold, rented, or used for advertising or mailing-list marketing.

sections.heading: Service providers and international processing
paragraphs: The site is hosted by Vercel, and Contact-form messages are delivered through Resend to a private inbox. These providers may process information outside Taiwan under their own policies.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Correspondence is kept only for as long as reasonably needed to respond, manage a possible or ongoing professional relationship, resolve disputes, protect the service, or meet applicable legal obligations.
When it is no longer needed, it is deleted or anonymized where reasonably possible.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may ask to access or review personal information connected to your inquiry, obtain a copy, supplement or correct it, stop its collection, processing, or use, or delete it. Submit the request through the Contact form and include enough detail to identify the correspondence.
The optional link is optional. If the required fields are not provided, the form cannot send the inquiry; you may still browse the portfolio.

sections.heading: Security and site measurement
paragraphs: The form uses HTTPS, restricted provider credentials, and basic abuse controls. No internet transmission or storage method is completely secure.
This portfolio does not include first-party advertising or analytics scripts. The hosting provider may still process technical request data needed to operate and secure the site.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: This notice may be updated when the portfolio's data practices or service providers change. The date above identifies the current version.

zh.metaDescription: 袁欣欣作品集如何處理透過聯絡表單提交的資料。
zh.intro: 本說明介紹透過這個作品集提交的資料會如何處理。本作品集由袁欣欣於台灣營運。

sections.heading: 誰處理你的資料
paragraphs: 袁欣欣決定透過本作品集提交之資料的使用目的。若有隱私權相關請求，可使用同一個作品集聯絡表單提出。

sections.heading: 收集哪些資料
paragraphs: 若使用聯絡表單，會收集你主動提供的姓名、電子信箱、合作類型、選填連結與訊息。
為了傳送與保護網站安全，託管服務也可能處理 IP 位址、瀏覽器或裝置資訊、時間戳記及請求紀錄等技術資料。

sections.heading: 使用目的
paragraphs: 資料只用於回覆洽詢、評估或討論可能的合作、保留必要的專業往來，以及防止表單遭到濫用。
資料不會出售、出租，也不會用於廣告或郵寄名單行銷。

sections.heading: 服務供應商與跨境處理
paragraphs: 網站由 Vercel 託管，聯絡表單訊息則透過 Resend 傳送到私人收件匣。這些供應商可能依其政策在台灣以外處理資料。

sections.heading: 保存期間
paragraphs: 往來資料只在回覆、管理可能或進行中的專業合作、處理爭議、保護服務，或履行適用法律義務所合理需要的期間內保留。
資料不再需要時，會在合理可行的範圍內刪除或匿名化。

sections.heading: 你的選擇與權利
paragraphs: 依適用法律，你可以請求查詢或閱覽與洽詢相關的個人資料、取得複製本、補充或更正資料、停止資料的蒐集、處理或利用，以及刪除資料。請透過聯絡表單提出，並提供足以辨識該筆往來的資訊。
參考連結是選填項目。若不提供必填欄位，表單便無法送出洽詢；你仍可瀏覽作品集。

sections.heading: 安全與網站量測
paragraphs: 表單使用 HTTPS、受限的供應商憑證及基本防濫用措施；但任何網路傳輸或儲存方式都無法保證絕對安全。
本作品集沒有加入第一方廣告或分析程式。託管供應商仍可能處理維持網站運作與安全所需的技術請求資料。

sections.heading: 更新
paragraphs: 作品集的資料處理方式或服務供應商若有變更，本說明可能隨之更新。頁首日期代表目前版本。
